_comment: Singapore November + December calendar automation. Daily images are composed from fixed master exports (assets/sg_masters/open_p<n>.png / booked_p<n>.png; pages 1-2 November, 3-4 December); the Canva designs are not touched day to day. Page 3 of the original design DAGsRHlSvkw (Sydney) is never used.
_auto_stories: false: only the feed is posted automatically. The story images are put on the stories page every morning and posted by hand (a link sticker cannot be added through the API).
_cancelled_in_stores: Reservations cancelled in the STORES dashboard (no mail is sent). Hashed reservation numbers: python3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'scripts'); from sg_calendar.ledger import _key; print(_key('NUMBER'))"
_pages: 11/7 から12月 (pages 3-4) だけ投稿。11月 (pages 1-2) は予約締め切り済み。
